# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> A well-located 3-bedroom home with attached garage and generous rear garden John Giltinane & Associates are delighted to bring to the market Seanachluain, 8 Desmond Drive, Adare, Co. Limerick. Situated in a great location within the popular village of Adare, this property offers well-proportioned accommodation together with an attached garage and a generously sized rear garden.

## Fakta
- Typ: semi-detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Lokalita: Seanachluain, 8 Desmond Drive, Adare
- Cena: 450 000 €
